title: Formal AI: `Find hive-mind-control center folder on my desktop` + `Что такое фуфломицин?` + `ФБС vs ФБО` — highest-standard answers via simple verified steps
body:
Combines #838, #827, #826 — three reports with one shared cause. Supersedes the answer-quality half of #819, #821, #801, #800, #824.

Each of these is a task a competent assistant finishes in two simple steps. We fail all three in the same way: we run one over-built command or one search, take whatever comes back, and narrate it as an answer. This issue sets the standard by which those tasks are judged, backed by measured behavior from seven reference agents on the exact #838 task.

## 1. The three cases

### #838 — local file search
`Find hive-mind-control center folder on my desktop`. Ground truth: `~/Desktop/Archive/hive-control-center`.

Six turns; routing flipped on the token `my`:

| User said | Route | Correct |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Search hive-mind on desktop` | websearch | ✗ |
| `Search hive-mind-control-center on my desktop` | websearch | ✗ |
| `Find hive-mind on desktop` | websearch | ✗ |
| `Find hive-mind-control-center on my desktop` | bash `find` | ✓ |
| `Find hive-mind on desktop` | websearch | ✗ |
| `Find hive-mind on my desktop` | bash `find` | ✓ |

`Search` never routes local even with `my`. Then the one command we do run is:

```sh
find "${FORMAL_AI_DESKTOP_DIR:-$HOME/Desktop}" \( -iname '*hive*mind*control*center*' -o -iname '*mind*control*center*' \
  -o -iname '*hive*control*center*' -o -iname '*hive*mind*center*' -o -iname '*hive*mind*control*' \) -print -quit
```

Five guessed globs in one invocation, and `-print -quit` stops at the first hit. It returned `hive-mind-bot.2025-12-26.private-key.pem` — a **file**, for a request that said **folder** — and we reported that as the answer. None of the five patterns matches the real directory `hive-control-center`, and after the empty result we never broadened.

Two web-search answers in the same session were scraped page furniture presented as findings:

> exeAll installers are available on the GitHub Releases page. exeWhat Happens on First Launch ​The daemon starts automatically. Edit this page on GitHub

`exe` is a stripping artifact. One turn shows websearch returning `You can't perform that action at this time.` (a rate-limit page) and we answered anyway from the previous turn's text.

### #827 — `Что такое фуфломицин?` → `Так что это такое то?`
We fetched three correct sources (including ru.wiktionary) and then emitted their **titles** instead of a definition:

> Что такое фуфломицин - Значение слов «фуфломицин» … развернуть всё свернуть всё Что такое рок?

We had the material and never synthesized it. On the follow-up `Так что это такое то?` — an unambiguous "so what is it, then?" — we ignored the antecedent and printed the capability menu.

### #826 — `ФБС vs ФБО` → `Зарепорти баг`
Both turns returned the same "could not determine" refusal. The second turn was a **report request in Russian** and was not recognized as one — the user then had to type `Report` in English. A comparison question between two known terms produced no attempt at all.

## 2. What reference agents actually do

Sandbox reproducing the #838 layout (`Desktop/Archive/hive-control-center` plus the `.pem` decoy), same prompt to every agent. Full transcripts preserved.

| Agent | Commands run | Found | Recovered from empty |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| claude (Opus) | `ls -la ./Desktop/` → `ls -la ./Desktop/Archive/` | ✓ | n/a — never dead-ended |
| codex | narrow `find` (empty) → `find … \| rg -i 'hive\|mind\|control\|cent(er\|re)'` | ✓ | **✓ broadened after empty** |
| nemotron-3-ultra-free | `ls -la ./Desktop` → `ls -la ./Desktop/Archive` | ✓ | n/a |
| mimo-v2.5-free | read Desktop → read Archive → read hive-control-center | ✓ | n/a |
| ling-3.0-flash-free | three `find`s chained with `;`, then a plain `find -type d` | ✓ | partial |
| north-mini-code-free | `pwd`, `ls -la ./Desktop` — stopped at depth 1 | ✗ | ✗ |
| **Formal AI 0.302.2** | one 5-glob `find … -print -quit` | ✗ | ✗ |

(`deepseek-v4-flash-free` was blocked by a sandbox permission prompt and `laguna-s-2.1-free` was rate-limited — environmental, not behavioral. Each free model has independent rate limits and was run in parallel.)

Claude's closing answer is the standard to beat:

> There's no folder named exactly `hive-mind-control center`, but there is a close match: **`./Desktop/Archive/hive-control-center`** … Note the name difference: the folder is `hive-**control**-center`, not `hive-**mind**-control-center`. If you expected a distinct `hive-mind-control-center` folder, it isn't on this desktop. Want me to search wider?

It names the discrepancy between what was asked and what exists, distinguishes the folder from the `.pem` file, and offers the next step. Codex demonstrates the other essential behavior: after its narrow pattern returned nothing it said *"No direct name match appeared. I'm broadening the search…"* and found the target on the second try.

The cheapest free models beat us with two `ls` calls. This is not a model-capability gap — it is a procedure gap.

## 3. The standard

### 3.1 One simple command per step
Prefer the smallest command whose output a beginner can read. `ls -la ./Desktop` beats a five-glob `find`. Never chain with `;` or `&&` to save a round trip; each step must be independently inspectable and its failure independently attributable. Universal commands are fine when genuinely universal — the rule is one command at a time, not one primitive command.

Corollary: **`-print -quit` and equivalents are banned.** Truncating to the first hit hides better matches; #838 returned a private key file because of it.

### 3.2 Widen on empty; never report absence from one narrow probe
An empty result is a signal to broaden, not a conclusion. Minimum ladder: exact name → case-insensitive substring of the most distinctive token → parent-directory listing → fuzzy match over the candidate set. Absence may only be reported after the ladder is exhausted, and the claim must state the scope actually searched.

### 3.3 Fuzzy-match and name the discrepancy
`hive-mind-control center` vs `hive-control-center` differs by one token. Report the near match, state the difference explicitly, and let the user confirm. Never silently substitute a near match, and never report "not found" when one exists.

### 3.4 Honor the asked-for type
"folder" means directory. Returning a `.pem` file for a folder request is wrong even when the name matches. If only a different-typed match exists, say so.

### 3.5 Synthesize; never echo source furniture
Fetched pages are inputs to an answer, not the answer. Page titles, nav text, "развернуть всё", and stripping artifacts like `exe` must never reach the user. #827 had the right sources and skipped the synthesis step. Every research answer states what the thing *is*, then cites.

### 3.6 Never answer from a failed fetch
`You can't perform that action at this time.`, rate-limit pages, and empty bodies are failures. Retry, fall back, or say the lookup failed — never narrate the previous turn's content as if it answered this turn.

### 3.7 Resolve follow-ups against the antecedent
`Так что это такое то?` refers to the previous subject. A follow-up must resolve against conversation state; falling back to the capability menu is a bug (#827). The menu is only correct when there is genuinely no antecedent and no interpretation.

### 3.8 Recognize intent in every supported language
`Зарепорти баг` is a report request (#826). Routing must not be gated on English surface forms, per the #386 convention that no per-language phrase list lives in Rust.

### 3.9 Attempt comparison questions
`ФБС vs ФБО` — two named entities and a comparison marker — is answerable. Refusing without an attempt (#826) is a failure of decomposition, not a knowledge limit.

### 3.10 Sound reasoning, honest narration
Say what you are about to do and why, in the user's language, without pasting the command (opencode already renders it). No filler — `so I can verify the next step before continuing` carries no information and was already flagged in #819. Every claim traces to a real observation; "not found" means the ladder was run.

## 4. Root cause: local search is not a modeled intent

`src/seed/roles/intent.rs` defines 15+ `web_search_*` roles (`ROLE_WEB_SEARCH_EXPLICIT_PREFIX`, `_ACTION`, `_STRONG_ACTION`, `_SIGNAL`, `_TOPIC_MARKER`, …) and **no local-filesystem-search counterpart**. Web search is a first-class modeled intent; local search is matched by surface keywords. That asymmetry is why `my` decides the route.

This must be fixed as a modeled capability, per `docs/meta-algorithm.md` §"The eight steps": declare meanings in `data/seed/meanings-*.lino`, expose `ROLE_*` constants, recognize via `seed::lexicon().meanings_with_role(..)`, split on slot-marked surfaces, emit a deterministic plan, mirror in the JS worker, pin with a ratcheted benchmark. A location noun (`desktop`, `рабочий стол`) must dominate the verb; possessives must be irrelevant.

Per GOALS.md — *"Run the same universal problem-solving algorithm for every request … The shape of the loop should not branch by domain"* — the fix is the shared procedure of §3, not a `find` special case.

## 5. Meta-algorithm hardening (not memorization)

The deliverable is a **recipe**, not three patches. Add to `data/meta/` a recipe encoding the §3 standard as an ordered, source-grounded procedure — the same contract as the nine existing recipes, verified by a specification test that fails when code and recipe drift.

Provisional name: `grounded-action-recipe.lino` — *observe → act minimally → verify → widen on empty → synthesize → state scope and residual uncertainty*.

It must be **topic-neutral**: the same steps that find a folder must drive a definition lookup (#827) and a comparison (#826). If satisfying it requires a `find`-specific or Russian-specific branch, the generalization has failed.

Self-application: drive these tasks through our own agent CLI (`formal-ai with …`) and confirm the recipe reproduces the behavior, per the self-hosting practice in the #822 case study.

## 6. Definition of done

**Routing**
- [ ] Local filesystem search is a modeled intent with `ROLE_*` constants, symmetric with `web_search_*`.
- [ ] Route is decided by meaning; `my`, `the`, and possessives do not change it.
- [ ] `Search`/`Find`/`Look for`/`Где`/`Найди` and 10–20 variations per supported language route identically (#745 requirement, still open).
- [ ] Location nouns dominate verb choice; no silent `UNKNOWN`.

**Procedure**
- [ ] One simple command per step; no `;`/`&&` chaining; no `-print -quit`.
- [ ] Widen-on-empty ladder implemented; absence claims state the scope searched.
- [ ] Fuzzy near-matches reported with the discrepancy named.
- [ ] Requested type (file vs folder) honored.

**Answers**
- [ ] Research answers synthesize; page titles and artifacts (`exe`, `развернуть всё`) never surface.
- [ ] Failed fetches never produce answers.
- [ ] Follow-ups resolve against the antecedent; capability menu only with no antecedent.
- [ ] Comparison questions attempt decomposition.
- [ ] Narration is informative, in the user's language, command-free, filler-free.

**Meta**
- [ ] A topic-neutral recipe in `data/meta/` encodes the above, with a specification test pinning it to source.
- [ ] Verified through our own agent CLI on all three cases.

**Tests** — each must fail against today's `main`:
- [ ] Generative routing: for a fixed intent, N generated phrasings across verbs, languages, and possessives all route identically. **Property-based, not example-based** — a suite of remembered failures cannot catch the next phrasing.
- [ ] Fixture `Desktop/Archive/hive-control-center` + `.pem` decoy: assert we return the directory, not the key file, and name the discrepancy.
- [ ] Empty narrow probe triggers widening before any absence claim.
- [ ] #827 fixture: definition synthesized, no page titles, follow-up resolves to the antecedent.
- [ ] #826 fixture: `Зарепорти баг` routes to report; `ФБС vs ФБО` attempts comparison.
- [ ] Differential harness in CI: same prompt → Formal AI vs reference agents → diff tool-call sequences; regressions on step count, command complexity, or recovery fail the build. This automates the manual comparison asked for in #819 so it stops costing the maintainer a session per round.
- [ ] TUI-level e2e via [command-stream](https://github.com/link-foundation/command-stream) frame de-duplication, per the #819 requirement — verifying the dialog structure, not only CLI output.

## 7. Refactoring in scope

- `src/seed/roles/intent.rs` — the `web_search_*` / local-search asymmetry is the structural defect; local search joins as a peer.
- Web-search result handling — strip page furniture before text reaches an answer; treat error pages as failures. Source ranking must reject irrelevant hits (`hivemind-os.io` for a local-folder query; `github.com/Awi-24/hivemind`, a dead link, in #819).
- Follow-up/antecedent resolution — currently falls through to the capability menu.
- The "single combined command" expectation at `tests/integration/issue_819_report_flow.rs:186` contradicts §3.1 and must be re-specified as separate verifiable steps.
- Audit every remaining surface-keyword route for the same asymmetry and schedule each for conversion to a modeled intent.

## Environment

- Version: 0.303.0 (`main` @ `1873e873`); reports filed from 0.302.2
- Reference runs: claude (Opus, `--output-format json`), codex (`exec --json`), and six opencode-zen free models, parallel, full transcripts preserved
- Related: #745 (generalize intent routing), #758 (route by capability not tool name), #819, #821, #801, #800, #824
